Vanguard.title: The Vanguard
Vanguard.loreInfo: The elite frontline shock troops of the dungeon, clad in thick, rusted iron.

Sun-King.title: The Sun-King
Sun-King.loreInfo: The tyrannical ruler of the surface realm. His light burns the eyes of the deep dwellers.

The Deep Flame.title: The Deep Flame
The Deep Flame.loreInfo: A primordial, sentient entity of fire that slumbers at the planet's core.

Order of the Light.title: Order of the Light
Order of the Light.loreInfo: Fanatical surface zealots sworn to eradicate all dungeon ecology.

The Warrens.title: The Warrens
The Warrens.loreInfo: The damp, overcrowded maze where the Swarm sleeps. Smells like wet dog and tactical genius. Mostly wet dog.

Black Iron.title: Black Iron
Black Iron.loreInfo: Heavy, jagged metal mined from the depths. It is the only thing the Bruisers respect, mostly because it is hard to chew.

Fungus Farms.title: The Fungus Farms
Fungus Farms.loreInfo: The dungeon's primary food source. Varieties include 'Lung-Cough Blue' and 'Death-Cap Delight.' High in fiber, higher in lethality.

The Great Ceiling.title: The Great Ceiling
The Great Ceiling.loreInfo: What the deep-dwellers call the Surface. A terrifying place where the roof is blue and the 'Sun' never stops screaming light.

Grave-Wax.title: Grave-Wax
Grave-Wax.loreInfo: Harvested from the remains of failed heroes. It provides a steady, flickering light and a scent that reminds everyone of their own mortality.

The Lesser Evil.title: The Lesser Evil
The Lesser Evil.loreInfo: A goblin philosophical concept used to decide which of two brothers to eat during a famine. It is the cornerstone of dungeon law.

Cimmerian Fog.title: Cimmerian Fog
Cimmerian Fog.loreInfo: A thick, supernatural vapor used to hide the fact that the Swarm hasn't cleaned the hallways in three centuries.

The Iron Pit.title: The Iron Pit
The Iron Pit.loreInfo: The training ground for the Bruisers. A place of grunts, sweat, and the occasional accidental decapitation. High morale, low life expectancy.

Rat-Stew.title: Rat-Stew
Rat-Stew.loreInfo: A culinary staple. If the tail is still twitching, it’s considered 'al dente.' If it talks back, it’s considered a council member.

Soul-Taxes.title: Soul-Taxes
Soul-Taxes.loreInfo: A mandatory tithe to the Deep Flame. Goblins often try to pay in 'good intentions.' They are usually incinerated for the attempt.

fear.title: Dread
fear.text: The terrifying presence you project. Too low, mutiny. Too high, paralysis.

horde.title: The Swarm
horde.text: The endless tide of lowly goblins. Keep them fed and breeding.

might.title: The Bruisers
might.text: Your heavy hitters—Uruks, trolls, and beasts. Keep them bashing.

loot.title: The Stash
loot.text: Shiny rocks, stolen armor, and moldy cheese. Keep it hoarded.

fear_low.title: The Laughing Stock
fear_low.description: The ranks no longer fear your shadow. They've turned your throne into a communal latrine and are currently using your crown to play 'toss the turnip.' You have been evicted.

fear_high.title: The Silent Tomb
fear_high.description: Your reign of terror was too successful. The goblins are so paralyzed by fear they've stopped eating, breathing, and moving. You rule a dungeon of petrified statues.

horde_low.title: The Lonely Overlord
horde_low.description: The last goblin has packed his bindle and left. The dungeon is empty, the torches have flickered out, and you're left arguing with the echoes.

horde_high.title: The Green Tide Rises
horde_high.description: Overpopulation has reached critical mass. The goblins have eaten the supplies, then the furniture, then... well, you always were the 'Big Meat.'

might_low.title: Paper Walls
might_low.description: A single surface-dweller toddler wandered in and accidentally tripped over your entire defense line. The Vanguard has dissolved into tears. You surrender to a five-year-old.

might_high.title: Military Coup
might_high.description: The Vanguard realized that if they can kill a Dragon, they can certainly kill a Boss who spends all day sitting on a throne. You are violently retired.

loot_low.title: Complete Bankruptcy
loot_low.description: You tried to pay the Uruks in 'exposure' and 'good vibes.' They preferred to pay themselves with your internal organs.

loot_high.title: The Wyrm's Visit
loot_high.description: Your hoard grew so bright it acted as a beacon for an Ancient Red Wyrm. It didn't even fight you; it just sat on the dungeon until everything flatlined.

char_1.name: Kargoth the Ironclad
char_1.flavor: A towering wall of muscle and rust. He speaks in grunts and violence.

char_2.name: Snivel the Goblin
char_2.flavor: A wretched creature from the deep warrens.

char_3.name: Uruk Warlord
char_3.flavor: A hulking brute demanding tribute or blood.

char_4.name: Greenfang Bruiser
char_4.flavor: Commander of the green tide. Thinks with his fists.

char_5.name: Blood Scarred Orc
char_5.flavor: A hardened veteran of a hundred surface raids.

char_6.name: The Shadow Priest
char_6.flavor: Chanter of the dark litanies and keeper of secrets.

char_7.name: Fallen Knight
char_7.flavor: An oathbreaker who found a new master in the dark.

char_8.name: Dungeon Merchant
char_8.flavor: A greedy peddler of cursed surface goods.

char_9.name: The Abyssal Warden
char_9.flavor: An ancient evil stirred from its long slumber.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Found a stash of rusted halberds. Arm my brutes, or melt them for scrap?

dialogues.text: Buried under the old latrine.
Tetanus is a feature, not a bug.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Make the Swarm serve my unit double rations. The small ones can starve.

dialogues.text: They can eat the rats. Or each other.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. I challenge you to a test of strength in the pit. Refuse, or risk your pride?

dialogues.text: No eye-gouging. Groin-kicking is strongly encouraged.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. I threw a goblin scout into the forge for 'talking back.' You gonna punish me?

dialogues.text: He makes a surprisingly good charcoal briquette.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Elf prisoners are aerodynamic. Let me use them as throwing weapons.

dialogues.text: The pointy ears act like stabilizing fins, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss... drank the forge-coolant. I am glowing. Can I hug a wizard?

dialogues.text: I am currently melting the floorboards with my feet.

nextCard.cardText: Boss. I bear-hugged the Grand Pyromancer. The explosion successfully vaporized him. Sorry about the west wing.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Found a 'pet' bear. It already ate three goblins. I'm keeping it.

dialogues.text: It only eats what bleeds. So, no.

nextCard.cardText: Boss. The bear broke loose, ate the master armor smith, and escaped into the tunnels. We need a new smith.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Red goes fasta. Buy me red paint for my armor, or I use goblin blood.

dialogues.btn: Does it actually make you faster?
dialogues.text: Science says yes, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. I invented 'Orc Yoga'. The cracking noises mean it's working. Make it mandatory?

dialogues.text: It is when I break a paladin's spine over my knee.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Swallowed the armory key. I feel 'secure.' We wait for it to pass, or you cut it out?
Master! We found a **shiny rock**, but it burns to touch!

dialogues.text: Sickly green! It makes my teeth hum, Master!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! We brewed a new mushroom stew! *It glows in the dark!*

dialogues.text: We used the mushrooms from the spider-caverns! They taste like colors!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master, the shiny rocks in the vault... we ate some. Now our tummies hurt *real bad*.

dialogues.text: The gold ones! We thought they were hard cheeses!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master, we built a **catapult!** It shoots other goblins! Can we test it?

dialogues.text: Gribble said he wanted to see the sun.

nextCard.cardText: Master! Gribble hit the ceiling, bounced off a stalactite, and landed in the gold vault! He crushed your favorite treasure chest!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! We found a door with a **big skull** on it! Should we knock?

dialogues.text: Just a sign that says 'Certain Doom.' Probably a surface bluff!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! The rat-catchers formed a guild! They demand extra mold on their bread!

dialogues.text: Three extra moldy crusts, or they stop eating the plague-rats!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master, we found a glowing orb. It keeps screaming prophecies about a 'Hero' in green. Smash it?

dialogues.text: Something about a 'Link to the Past.' It's very annoying.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! I found a **Magic Window**! When I look in, another handsome goblin looks back!

dialogues.text: I pinched it from the shiny elf-man's bag!

nextCard.cardText: Master... I smashed the mirror. A rogue shard of glass bounced up and severed the Chief Treasurer's ear.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! We found a pile of surface-dweller 'Health Insurance' forms. Can we eat them?

dialogues.text: Very dry! But the 'Co-Pay' section has a nice crunch!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master, we built a monument to you out of mud and old bones! It smells awful!

dialogues.btn: Is that supposed to be my nose?
dialogues.text: Yes! The femur really captures your majestic profile!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master, some of the boys started a union. They want 'Safety Railings' over the lava pits.

dialogues.text: Gribble fell in yesterday. He didn't even leave a good splash.

nextCard.cardText: Master... the boys thought the railings were gymnastics equipment. Three dozen just swung right into the magma.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! We found a shiny golden cup! We have been using it to scoop out the latrines.
Master! A human adventurer dropped a 'Cookbook'. Now the cooks refuse to serve anything raw!
Overlord. The men of the West are marching on our upper gates.

dialogues.text: Enough to drown our Vanguard in blood. We should use the traps.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. My Uruks demand a larger share of the plunder to stay in line. Pay up.

dialogues.text: Then we take it out of your hide, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I want to challenge the **Greenfang Bruiser** to a duel for supremacy of the [[Vanguard]].

dialogues.text: I will wear his skull as a codpiece.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. We captured a dwarven engineer. I want to torture him. The goblins want him to build traps.

dialogues.text: He muttered something about a 'Meat-Grinder 3000'.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. My troops complain the torture chambers lack 'ambiance'. Let me impale them atmospherically.

dialogues.text: At a 45-degree angle, facing the scenic lava falls.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. The dwarven king sent a formal scroll demanding we stop chanting at midnight. I intend to eat the messenger.

dialogues.text: It was heavily perfumed and asked politely. Disgusting.

nextCard.cardText: Pathetic. The dwarven messenger was wearing concealed spiked armor. I am now in the infirmary with a perforated colon.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. My [[Vanguard]] complains of 'Work-Life Balance'. They want Tuesdays off to pillage for fun.

dialogues.text: Only if you aren't doing it for a strict quota, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. My scouts captured an elven bard. He won't stop playing the lute. It is demoralizing.
Overlord. I demand better siege engines. We cannot conquer the surface with sharpened logs.
Overlord. My lieutenant challenged me for command. I can crush him, but he is a skilled fighter.
Boss! Da boyz want better meat. *Rat meat ain't cuttin' it no more.*
Boss! Puny humans built a wooden fort near our cave. Let me smash it!
Boss! Dis armor is too tight. I want new plates made of pure gold!

dialogues.text: But it's SHINY, Boss! Imagine the glare in their eyes!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! Da boyz are bored. Can we have a *fight pit*? Winner gets extra grog!

dialogues.text: Da Swarm usually eats 'em before they get cold.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! Da boyz wanna start a 'Choir'. It's just two hours of us screaming at a rock.

dialogues.text: 'Blood on the Rocks' in G-flat. Very emotional.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! I punched a wall and found a hidden room full of cursed dwarven ledgers. Should we burn 'em?

dialogues.text: Yeah, looking at the tax rates makes my eyes bleed.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! Da boyz caught a troll. It says it wants to be an accountant. Should we smash it?

dialogues.text: It counted to three before biting off its own finger.

nextCard.cardText: Boss, the troll ate the financial ledger and declared bankruptcy. But he scared off the surface tax collectors!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! I challenged a stalagmite to a headbutting contest. I lost. Da boyz are laughing at me.

dialogues.text: It had a very solid defensive stance, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! We looted a carriage full of fancy silk hats. Can we wear them into battle?
Boss! I want to grease the entrance ramp. Any hero running in will slide right into a wall.

dialogues.text: Leftover Rat-Stew. Extra slippery.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. I caught a surface thief sneaking into the lower vaults. Flay him?

dialogues.btn: What did he try to steal?
dialogues.text: A single copper coin. The audacity is what offends me.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. I remember the layout of the [[Sun-King]]'s armory. Give me 100 men and I'll bring back **steel**.

dialogues.text: Soft as butter. But they have shiny spears.

nextCard.cardText: The raid was a success, Boss. The Sun-King's guards fought fiercely, but I brought back carts of steel. I am only missing half my jaw.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. My old wounds ache. The winter is cold. I need the ***Shadow Priest***'s dark magic to fight.
Boss. Found some surface *grog*. It makes the boyz fight harder... and die faster.
Boss. I've survived eighty raids, but the new recruits keep polishing their armor instead of sharpening their axes. Can I flay them?
Boss. An elf shot me in the kidney with a glowing arrow. I kept it as a torch. Can I have a sick day?
Boss. The new recruits don't even know how to properly sever a limb! They need live practice.
Boss. Back in my day, we didn't have 'healing potions.' We rubbed dirt in our wounds! Ban the potions.

dialogues.text: Infection builds character, Boss!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. I found an orphaned human baby during the raid. It looked at me... and didn't cry.

dialogues.text: No! It just... has a very good battle-cry.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. My axe is rusted dull, but it holds the blood of a hundred kings. The smith wants to melt it.
Overlord. The dark altar requires a sacrifice of **royal blood** to awaken the old ones.

dialogues.btn: Where do we find a prince?
dialogues.text: I have a coupon for the local kingdom.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. The stars align in a bloody crescent. We must sacrifice the *plumpest goblins* tonight.

dialogues.text: The Old Ones appreciate good marbling, Overlord.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I can bind the screaming souls of fallen heroes to our [[Vanguard]]'s armor. It requires a tithe of **gold**.
Overlord. The whispers from the deep abyss are getting louder. Should I answer them?
Overlord. The Abyss demands a virgin sacrifice, but there's a blizzard outside. Can we just use a particularly pure goblin?
Overlord. I accidentally summoned a lesser demon of misplaced items. Now all the armory keys are missing.

dialogues.text: I lost the banishing scroll.

nextCard.cardText: Overlord, smashing the doors triggered the arcane wards. The armory is open, but half the Vanguard is permanently singed and terrified.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. [[The Deep Flame]] is hungry, but the sacrificial pits are closed for a 'Mandatory Safety Inspection'.
Overlord. I have started a 'Book Club' reading the Necronomicon. The goblins are taking it surprisingly well.
Overlord. Tentacles are coming out of the plumbing again. The plumbers require hazard pay.

dialogues.text: We tried. The plunger was consumed, along with the plumber.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. The dark gods demand a '[[Soul-Taxes|Void Tax]].' 20% of all shiny rocks must be thrown into the abyss.

dialogues.text: The Abyss forecloses on our mortal coils.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. My chanting is causing the stalactites to fall and crush the workers. Should I hum instead?
My Lord. My former brothers-in-arms seek to redeem me. Let me crush them to prove my loyalty.
My Lord. A paladin of the [[Order of the Light]] approaches the dungeon alone. I request the honor of a duel.
My Lord. My rusted armor reminds me of my failure to the light. Forge me a new suit of **dark steel**.

dialogues.text: It absorbs the light, much like my crushing despair.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. The goblins lack discipline. They are pathetic. Let me train them... brutally.
My Lord. My spiked armor of eternal suffering is chafing terribly. May I line it with velvet?
My Lord. The Paladins sent me a bouquet of holy warding-garlic to 'cure' me. It smells... delicious. What do I do?
Overlord. A squire from the [[Order of the Light]] is weeping in the dungeons. He looks like my son... let him go?

dialogues.text: His resolve is weak, but his heart is still stubbornly pure.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Lord. The Goblins mock my vows of dark chivalry. They do not understand the etiquette of a proper duel.
My Lord. I wish to mount an expedition to retrieve my old horse's skeleton and reanimate it as my steed.

dialogues.text: Her name is Buttercup, and she is a terror on the battlefield.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Lord. My old holy sword burns my hand, but it is a mastercrafted weapon. Melt it into spikes?
Overlord. I have a rare, **cursed artifact** from the surface. Yours for a bag of gold.

dialogues.text: It makes you incredibly wealthy, but terribly paranoid.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. Got a fresh shipment of healing potions. They are slightly expired, *but cheap!*

dialogues.text: They taste like vinegar and occasionally cause spontaneous combustion.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I found a map to a hidden vein of **dark iron**. I need funding to start the mining operation.
Overlord. The **Shadow Priest** owes me coin for incense. Collect it for me, and I'll cut you in.
Overlord. I am selling naming rights to the new slime pits. Interested in the 'Overlord's Vats of Agony' package?
Overlord. I've devised a multi-tiered scheme involving cursed wishing coins. Want in on the ground floor?
Overlord. Business is slow. Let's install a **Gift Shop** at the end of the Hall of Screams. Tourists love keychains.
Overlord. I'm introducing 'Non-Fungible Trinkets.' It's just regular rocks, but I tell the Uruks they are rare.

dialogues.text: Uruks aren't known for their financial literacy. Yes.

nextCard.cardText: Overlord, the Uruks quickly realized the rocks are everywhere. They are now throwing the 'currency' at my head.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord, inflation has hit the dungeon. A single bowl of [[Rat-Stew]] now costs 40 gold pieces. Do we fix prices?
Overlord. I want to sell 'Mystery Loot Boxes' to the [[Vanguard]]. It's mostly just rusty spoons.
Overlord, a noble from the surface wants to buy a timeshare in our torture chambers for his 'vacations.'
OVERLORD. MY SEALS ARE WEAKENING. THE HORRORS YEARN FOR FREEDOM.

dialogues.text: THINGS WITH FAR TOO MANY KNEES.

DECK_JSON.prompt: OVERLORD. THE DEEP WATER... IT HUNGERS FOR THE **SHINY METAL**. ==FEED IT.==

dialogues.text: IT LIKES THE REFLECTIONS OF THE DROWNING.

DECK_JSON.prompt: OVERLORD. THE LITTLE GREEN ONES MULTIPLY TOO FAST. THEY MAKE GOOD KINDLING FOR [[The Deep Flame]].
OVERLORD. A RIFT IN REALITY OPENS IN THE CATACOMBS. *PEER INSIDE?*

dialogues.text: I SEE A DIMENSION OF INFINITE SPREADSHEETS AND CUBICLES. TRULY TERRIFYING.

nextCard.cardText: OVERLORD. THREE GOBLINS LOOKED INTO THE RIFT AND INSTANTLY FORMED AN HR DEPARTMENT. MORALE HAS PLUMMETED.

DECK_JSON.prompt: OVERLORD. THE MORTALS HAVE INVENTED 'PAPER MONEY'. IT LACKS THE TASTE OF SOULS. SHALL WE BURN THEIR BANKS?
OVERLORD. MY TENTACLES ARE TANGLED IN THE LEY-LINES. THE WARLOCKS ARE RIOTING OVER THE MAGICAL INTERFERENCE.
OVERLORD. ==THE VOICES== TELL ME YOU ARE JUST A REFLECTION IN A CRYSTAL SLAB HELD BY A GIANT. BREAK THE SLAB?
OVERLORD. REALITY IS THINNING IN THE LOWER DEPTHS. GEOMETRY NO LONGER MAKES SENSE. CHARGE ADMISSION?
OVERLORD. I HAVE ADOPTED A MORTAL KITTEN. IF ANYONE HARMS IT, I WILL UNMAKE THE CONCEPT OF TIME.
OVERLORD. THE STARS ARE WRONG TODAY. I WISH TO SLEEP FOR A THOUSAND YEARS. DO NOT WAKE ME.
OVERLORD. AN EXISTENTIAL DREAD HAS GRIPPED MY PERCEPTION OF THE HORDE. THEY REALIZE THEIR LIVES ARE JUST NUMBERS.
Boss. The Swarm's screeching gives my Bruisers migraines. Let me 'repurpose' [[The Warrens]] as a quiet zone.

dialogues.text: They sing about fungus. Terribly.

nextCard.cardText: Master! The evicted goblins are sleeping in the treasury. They are eating the gold coins, thinking they are shiny beetles!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! We found a 'Bar of Soap' in a Paladin's kit. The boys want to know if it's an edible holy relic.

dialogues.text: Lavender and judgment.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I'm offering 'Disruption Insurance.' If a Hero clears a floor, I pay you out. Premium is just a few chests of gold.
Boss. My Bruisers are getting soft. They want 'Participation Trophies' for every village burned. Should I flay the sentiment out of them?
Overlord. [[The Deep Flame]] is flickering. I suggest we toss in the 'Employee of the Month' to brighten the mood.

dialogues.text: A particularly enthusiastic goblin named 'Lunch.'

nextCard.cardText: LUNCH WAS ADEQUATE. I AM PLEASED. I DEMAND DESSERT.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Lord. I attempted to teach the Swarm the 'Shield Wall' formation. They used the shields as sleds to race down the lava chutes.
Boss. My Bruisers have unionized. We demand 'Hazard Pay' for fighting Wizards. Being turned into sheep is unprofessional.

dialogues.text: Enough to start a wool export business.

nextCard.cardText: Overlord, the new 'sheep' recruits are terrible at fighting, but I have made a fortune selling their wool.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! The [[Rat-Stew]] has started talking back to the cooks! It's demanding a seat on the High Council!
Overlord. I have a crate of 'Tactical Glitter.' Throw it at a Hero to reveal their invisible armor... or just make them fabulous.
OVERLORD. I HAVE FOUND THE END OF THE SCRIPT. BEYOND THIS CARD LIES ONLY THE BLANK WHITE VOID OF AN UNPAID DEVELOPER'S AMBITION.
Overlord. I suggest we replace the torches with '[[Grave-Wax]] Candles.' They smell of ancient rot and provide a most becoming gloom.
Master! We found a **wildflower** growing in the sludge. Its colors are... *revoltingly* bright. Shall we burn the contamination?
Boss. I want to host a 'Family Reunion' for my clan. It involves three days of mandatory screaming and traditional poison-tasting.
Overlord. I am undone. The spikes on your 'Iron Maiden' are too blunt to provide a truly *soulful* experience.

dialogues.text: You could comfortably rest a baby on them. It's humiliating.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I’ve imported some 'Premium [[Cimmerian Fog]].' It’s thick enough to choke a dragon and hides the unsightly lack of cobwebs in the hallway.
Boss. I am feeling nostalgic. Let me recreate my first raid by setting fire to the Swarm's favorite [[Fungus Farms]].
Boss. Found a 'Baby's First Rattle' in a caravan. I am using it to beat a goblin scout rhythmically. It's quite musical.
OVERLORD. A GUST OF BITTER, FRIGID AIR HAS SWEPT THE CATACOMBS. IT FEELS LIKE THE COLD EMBRACE OF A FORGOTTEN ANCESTOR. DELIGHTFUL, ISN'T IT?
Boss! Da boyz are demanding 'Formal Battle Shrouds.' We refuse to pillage unless we look appropriately cadaverous!
Overlord. I have curated a 'Gallery of Agony'. It is merely Goblins attempting basic math. It is my masterpiece.
Boss. I've seen three Dark Lords fall. They all started with golden statues and ended as charcoal. Maybe we just... buy better boots instead?

dialogues.text: A solid pair of boots won't plot to overthrow you.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! A 'Hero' is at the gate. He says he's here for a 'Prophecy,' but he looks like he'd sell his mother for a warm pint. Should we hire him as a scout?

nextCard.cardText: Master... the 'Hero' was heavily intoxicated. The pit monsters are now drunk and refusing to work. They are currently singing sea shanties.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I am profoundly bored. The Abyss demands a sacrifice, or a very long, very dry lecture on the philosophy of nothingness.
Overlord, a shipment of 'Anti-Paladin Repellent' arrived. It’s mostly just garlic and offensive jokes about the [[Sun-King]]. Want the 'Premium' batch?
Boss. I found a surface Knight who claims he's 'neutral.' He wants a permit to hunt the slime in the basement for 'research.'

dialogues.text: He wears two swords on his back, which seems excessive and try-hard.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. Honor is a fine thing, but it doesn't stop an Orc from gutting you. Let me teach the Swarm to fight 'dirty.'
Boss! Da boyz caught a Bard. He offered to write a ballad about your 'magnificent cruelty' if we don't eat his legs. Is it art, or is it lunch?

nextCard.cardText: Boss! The bard's legs were quite gamey, but his lingering screams provided excellent background ambiance for the feast.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. If I bash a skull in a forest and no one hears it... did I really bash it? My head hurts from thinking.
OVERLORD. THE VOICES IN THE WALLS COMPLAIN THAT THE DUNGEON IS BECOMING 'QUITE GENTRIFIED.' THEY PREFERRED IT WHEN THE FLOOR WAS MOSTLY BLOOD AND FILTH.
Master! The Swarm wants a 'Union Rep.' They say being 'Disposable' should at least come with a dental plan.
Overlord. The Dungeon Merchant is selling 'Sacrificial Indulgences' to the Swarm. For ten gold, a goblin is exempt from Abyssal rituals. I am furious.
Boss. Dwarven sappers have breached the lower armory. They are strapped with explosives. If they blow, we lose the [[Black Iron]].

nextCard.cardText: Boss. My Bruisers successfully killed the dwarves, but the resulting explosion turned our best elites into a fine mist. The iron is safe, though.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss. Our armor is rusting directly into our flesh. To peel it off means flaying half my men alive. To leave it means we move like stone statues.

dialogues.text: Only when we breathe. Or swing an axe. Or exist.

nextCard.cardText: Boss. The rusted Bruisers are now practically invincible, but they are so heavy they accidentally crush a dozen goblins just walking to the latrine.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! A glowing surface-maiden wandered into the traps. She offers a 'Blessing of Endless Wealth' if we simply let her walk away.

nextCard.cardText: Boss! The 'blessing' was a localized blast of holy light. The treasury is overflowing, but the front row of the Vanguard is now permanently blind.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. A surface village sent a diplomat. They will pay us a monthly gold tribute if we sign a contract agreeing to only eat their elderly.

dialogues.text: Stringy, but they come with their own seasoning. Mostly lint.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Master! The [[Rat-Stew]] militia is marching on the throne room! It demands we stop eating its 'brethren' or face its salty wrath!

nextCard.cardText: Boss. The Swarm ate the sentient stew. The stew is now organizing a revolt from inside their stomachs. Productivity is at an all-time low.

DECK_JSON.prompt: OVERLORD. MY TENTACLES ARE ROTTING FROM THE DAMP. I REQUIRE FRESH LIMBS. SHALL I TAKE THEM FROM THE ORCS OR THE GOBLINS?
My Lord. The gold vault ceiling is collapsing. We must brace it immediately. Do we use expensive [[Black Iron]] beams, or stack goblin bodies?
Boss. My armor split. The boys are laughing. Give me vault gold to reforge it, or I fight the Paladins bare-chested.
Master! We found a surface-wizard's spellbook! It’s very soft. Can the Swarm use the pages for toilet paper?

nextCard.cardText: Master... the runes on the pages reacted poorly to the latrines. Half the warrens just exploded into purple fire.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Overlord. I have a map to the Sun-King's supply lines. Give me half the Swarm to dig a tunnel, and we will bleed his caravans dry.
Overlord. The Abyss is whisper-quiet today. I fear it is pouting. Should I toss in a dozen of your elite Bruisers to cheer it up, or will you surrender the gold vault?
Boss. The young ones are using my legendary axe to chop 'Death-Cap' fungus. Flay them for me, or I walk out that door.

dialogues.text: It smells like mushroom soup and disrespect.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boss! Da goblins made a 'Union'! I don't know what that is, but I wanna smash it! Give the word!
My Lord. The paladins left a cursed mirror at our gates that reflects one's truest regrets. The Orcs are staring into it and weeping. Smash it?
OVERLORD. THE LEY-LINES ARE SHIFTING. IF YOU DO NOT FEED ME YOUR FINEST MEAT, I WILL REARRANGE THE STAIRS SO THEY ONLY GO DOWN.
Boss. The Swarm's breeding pits are overflowing into my training grounds. I am going to initiate a cull unless you build them new warrens.
Master! We found a strange, glowing liquid dripping from the ceiling. It tastes like burning! Should we put it in the [[Rat-Stew]]?

nextCard.cardText: Boss! The liquid was liquid rage! My Bruisers ate the stew and are in a frenzy, tearing the dungeon apart!
